title: Guest Care Standard: Travel-Issue Fee Base by Issue Category
content:
# Guest care standard — what the travel-issue fee base holds

**Clause.** On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, what the travel-issue fee base holds depends on the issue: for a misrepresented listing, Roamhaven answers for the listing it published, so the fee base is the nightly refund on the ledger for the travel issue plus the whole cleaning fee of the stay; for a guest who could not get in or a place that was unsafe or unsanitary, reported on the check-in date, the fee base is the nightly and cleaning-fee refunds on the ledger for the travel issue; for any other issue it is the nightly refund on the ledger for the travel issue.

The issue category and submission date are those of the approved travel-issue request (the one decided most recently, where there is more than one); the refunds are the entries with the travel-issue reason on the stay's ledger; the cleaning fee is the one in the stay's price breakdown.

## Cases (hypothetical: travel-issue nightly refund 600.00, stay cleaning fee 120.00)

| Category | Reported | Travel-issue cleaning-fee refund on the ledger | Fee base |
|---|---|---|---|
| Misrepresented | any day | none | 600.00 plus 120.00: 720.00 |
| No access | on the check-in date | 120.00 | 720.00 |
| Uninhabitable | on the check-in date | 120.00 | 720.00 |
| Uninhabitable | the day after check-in | none | 600.00 |
| Amenity missing | on the check-in date | none | 600.00 |
